{{Quote|Hey, listen buddy. If the Impies find me on board, I'm Wampameat. On second thought, if they find me, ''you're'' Wampameat. Catch my drift?|Tantos Dree|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Tantos Dree''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. For a time, he travelled with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], aboard the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' alongside [[Jill Farseeker]] and [[Jackson Farseeker]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Dree had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of ten thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] levied on him by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Tantos Dree was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During his career, Dree was wanted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was placed on his head. At some point, he was aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', as it left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thorgeld I]] along with the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], Garnet's daughter, [[Jill Farseeker|Jill]], and her grandfather, [[Jackson Farseeker]]. While breaking [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the ''Dorion Discus'' was hailed by the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']] wanting to perform a customs inspection. Dree made it clear to Garnet that the Imperials could not discover him aboard, or the smuggler would face the consequences. Jill suggested that they could hide Dree by having him exit the vessel and trailing behind the ship holding onto a [[Rope/Legends|rope]]. Not a fan of "being strung up like a [[Yo-yo|yoyo]]," Dree took matters into his own hands and manned the weaponry of the ''Dorion Discus''. At the same time, Farseeker had been making the calculations for a jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Garnet attempted to bluff the ''Assessor'' by claiming to have a priority cargo for the [[Unidentified Imperial base (Markon IV)|Imperial base]] on [[Markon IV]], but failed to convince the Imperials aboard who fired a warning shot across the ''Dorion Discus''{{'s}} bow and gave them a final warning to heave to.<ref name="RPG" />

As Garnet started evasive maneuvers, Dree managed to get two shots off at the ''Assessor'' before the ''Dorion Discus'' made the jump and he missed both times. Seeing the characteristic visual phenomena of the jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], Dree expressed his relief that they were safely away. However, the ''Dorion Discus''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] had not managed to block one of the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blasts that the ''Assessor'' had fired at it. Almost immediately after Dree had made the remark, an ominous clicking sound began to originate from the freighter's upper [[Hull/Legends|hull]], in addition to slight fluctuations in its power output. Some time later, an [[Unidentified con artist|individual]] attempted to recruit some help in rescuing their friends from Dree, although it was part of a con.<ref name="RPG" />

==Personality and traits==
Dree was a bounty hunter with an aggressive and hard-bitten personality. Wanted by the Empire, he has no qualms about threatening his companions to ensure his safety, or firing at Imperial ships. Despite this, he was only moderately trained to use the weapons aboard small space [[Transport/Legends|transports]], and missed a target ten times the size of the ''Dorion Discus'' over Thorgeld.<ref name="RPG" />
